title: The 5 most overhyped tech trends of 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hey, you’re still scrolling? Think again — 2026’s tech hype is out of control.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just about gadgets — it’s about real money and real mistakes.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Quantum AI wearables promise to hack your brain — with no proven results.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The most talked-about feature? A 0.001% performance boost in virtual meetings.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tech bros and investors are falling for it — even though the science is shaky.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: hype doesn’t equal progress — especially when the data is thin.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s the biggest tech lie you’ve bought into? Comment below.
